scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:plugins && electron-vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-common && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-project && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-release && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @appilot-labs/appilot && npm run typecheck -w @appilot-labs/appilot-headless-cli && npm run typecheck -w @appilot-labs/appilot-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:plugins && npm test -w @appilot-labs/appilot-project && npm test -w @appilot-labs/appilot-release && npm test --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-core && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && npm test --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-headless && npm test --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-scheduler && npm test --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-headless-cli && npm test --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-mcp
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-core && npm run build --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-headless && npm run build --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-scheduler && npm run build --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-headless-cli && npm run build --workspace=@appilot-labs/appilot-mcp
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-common && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-project && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot-release && npm run build -w @appilot-labs/appilot
